# Species accumulation curves

```{r}
# Distance

occ_wol_acc <- occ_wol_cost %>%
  filter(status.native_anywhere_in_aus != "unknown") %>%
  arrange(source, nearest_distances) %>%   # sort within group
  group_by(source) %>%
  mutate(accum_species = cumsum(!duplicated(species))) %>%
  ungroup()

acc_wol_dist <-
ggplot() +
  geom_step(occ_wol_acc, mapping=aes(x = nearest_distances, y = accum_species, colour = source)) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#BB0011","#5566AA"), name ="Record Type") + 
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,8500)) +
   scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Accumulated Species") +
   theme_bw() +
   theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
         axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
         axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
         axis.title.y = element_blank(),
         axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
         axis.ticks.y = element_blank())

occ_bmk_acc <- occ_bmk_cost %>%
  filter(status.native_anywhere_in_aus != "unknown") %>%
  arrange(source, nearest_distances) %>%   # sort within group
  group_by(source) %>%
  mutate(accum_species = cumsum(!duplicated(species))) %>%
  ungroup()

acc_bmk_dist <- ggplot() +
  geom_step(occ_bmk_acc, mapping=aes(x = nearest_distances, y = accum_species, colour = source)) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#BB0011","#5566AA"), name ="Record Type") + 
  labs( x = "Distance from track (m)", y = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,8500)) +
   theme_bw()+ 
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
         axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
         axis.ticks.y = element_blank())

```

```{r}
# Number of records
set.seed(1)

n_perm <- 100

occ_wol_perm <- do.call(rbind, lapply(1:n_perm, function(i) {
  occ_wol_cost %>%
    filter(status.native_anywhere_in_aus != "unknown") %>%
    group_by(source) %>%
    slice_sample(prop = 1) %>%
    mutate(record_id = row_number(),
           accum_species = cumsum(!duplicated(species)),
           perm = i) %>%
    ungroup()
}))

occ_wol_acc_rec <- occ_wol_perm %>%
  group_by(source, record_id) %>%
  summarise(accum_species = mean(accum_species), .groups = "drop")

acc_wol_rec <- 
  ggplot() +
  geom_step(occ_wol_acc_rec, mapping = aes(x = record_id, y = accum_species, colour = source)) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#BB0011","#5566AA"), name ="Record Type") + 
  labs(x = "Number of records", y = "Wollemi\nCumulative unique species ") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,17500)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1100)) +
  theme_bw() 
  # theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  #       axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
  #       axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

set.seed(2)

n_perm <- 100

    group_by(source) %>%
    slice_sample(prop = 1) %>%
    mutate(record_id = row_number(),
           accum_species = cumsum(!duplicated(species)),
           perm = i) %>%
    ungroup()
}))

occ_bmk_acc_rec <- occ_bmk_perm %>%
  group_by(source, record_id) %>%
  summarise(accum_species = mean(accum_species), .groups = "drop")

acc_bmk_rec <-

  geom_step(occ_bmk_acc_rec, mapping = aes(x = record_id, y = accum_species, colour = source)) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#BB0011","#5566AA"), name ="Record Type") + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,17500)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1100)) +
  labs(x = "Number of records", y = "Blue Mountains and Kanagra\nCumulative unique species") +
  theme_bw()

(acc_wol_rec + acc_bmk_rec) +
plot_layout(ncol = 2, nrow = 1, guides = 'collect') &
theme(legend.position = "right")


      ggsave(
        filename = paste0(WKDir,"/Figure drafts/accumulated_spp.png"),

        height = 5,
        dpi = 300
      )
```

# Map

```{r}
library(ozmaps)
library(maps)
```


```{r}
lga <- read_sf(dsn = paste0(WKDir,"Map data/LGA_2025_AUST_GDA2020/LGA_2025_AUST_GDA2020.shp"))
pop <- read.csv(paste0(WKDir,"Map data/ABS_LGA_2025.csv"))

lga_pop_aus <- lga %>%
  left_join(pop, by = "LGA_NAME25")

lga_pop_aus$OBS_VALUE <- as.numeric(lga_pop_aus$OBS_VALUE)


pop_aus <- terra::rast(paste0(WKDir, "Map data/GEOTIFF/apgr25_1_0_0.tif"))
pop_aus_10 <- terra::aggregate(pop_aus, fact = 10, fun = sum)

```






```{r}
map_info <-list(name=c("New South Wales","ACT","Queensland","Victoria","Tasmania", "Sydney"), lat=c("-30.81937","-35.29879","-26.73785", "-36.64907", "-42.04160","-33.85054"), long=c("146.86407","149.09885", "146.53661", "144.52213","146.70751", " 151.76835"))
map_df<-as.data.frame(map_info)
map_sf <- st_as_sf(map_df, coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326)


info <-list(name=c("Blue Mountains and\nKanangra National Parks","Wollemi National Park"), lat=c("-33.74889","-32.96797"), long=c("148.37292", "148.37292"))
info_df<-as.data.frame(info)
info_sf <- st_as_sf(info_df, coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326)
```

Her barium cutout plots
```{r}
cost_plot <-  
    ggplot() +
    
    # cost surface 
    geom_spatraster(data = crop_cost_surface_bmk, maxcell=10000000,alpha=70,) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours=grDevices::hcl.colors(50, "YlOrBr", rev = TRUE), limits = c(0, 7), na.value = "white",name="Cost (Estimated hours)") +
    
    # Tracks background
    geom_sf(data = crop_osm_background_bmk, aes(geometry=geometry), key_glyph = draw_key_path, col="grey85", lwd=0.3) +
    geom_sf(data = crop_osm_road_bmk, aes(geometry=geometry),col="grey70", key_glyph = draw_key_path, lwd=0.4) +
    # Tracks
    geom_sf(data = crop_bmk_tr_gda94, aes(geometry=geometry, color = highway_com), key_glyph = draw_key_path, lwd=0.4) +
    scale_color_manual(values=c("#88BBAA","#5566AA","#BB0011","#E69F00"), name ="Track Type") + 
    ggnewscale::new_scale_colour() +
    
    # points
    geom_sf(data = crop_occ_bmk_cost_inat, aes(colour = as.factor(status.native_anywhere_in_aus), size = as.factor(status.native_anywhere_in_aus), geometry = geometry), shape = 16, stroke = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("orange","#666633","#99BB55" ), name = "Native Status" ) +
    scale_size_manual(values =c(1.5,2, 2),name = "Native Status")+
    
    geom_text(data = crop_ml_bmk, aes(label = location, geometry = geometry), col="grey40", stat = "sf_coordinates", size = 3) +
  annotation_scale(location = "br", width_hint = 0.2) +
    
    # plot design
    coord_sf() +
    theme_bw() + theme(legend.key = element_rect(fill="grey90")) +
    scale_x_continuous( expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +

    labs(x = "", y="")
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(WKDir,"output_bmk/plots/crop_cost_rast_bmk_inat.png"),
    width = 10,
    height = 15,
    dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
cost_plot <-  
    ggplot() +
    
    # cost surface 
    geom_spatraster(data = crop_cost_surface_wol, maxcell=10000000,alpha=70,) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours=grDevices::hcl.colors(50, "YlOrBr", rev = TRUE), limits = c(0, 7), na.value = "white",name="Cost (Estimated hours)") +
    
    # Tracks background
    geom_sf(data = crop_osm_background_wol, aes(geometry=geometry), key_glyph = draw_key_path, col="grey85", lwd=0.3) +
    geom_sf(data = crop_osm_road_wol, aes(geometry=geometry),col="grey70", key_glyph = draw_key_path, lwd=0.4) +
    # Tracks
    geom_sf(data = crop_wol_tr_gda94, aes(geometry=geometry, color = highway_com), key_glyph = draw_key_path, lwd=0.4) +
    scale_color_manual(values=c("#88BBAA","#5566AA","#BB0011","#E69F00"), name ="Track Type") + 
    ggnewscale::new_scale_colour() +
    
    # points
    geom_sf(data = crop_occ_wol_cost_herb, aes(colour = as.factor(status.native_anywhere_in_aus), size = as.factor(status.native_anywhere_in_aus), geometry = geometry), shape = 16, stroke = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = if (length(unique(crop_occ_wol_cost_herb$status.native_anywhere_in_aus)) == 2) { c( "#666633","#99BB55") } else { c("#99BB55", "#666633", "orange")}, name = "Native Status" ) +
    scale_size_manual(values = if (length(unique(crop_occ_wol_cost_herb$status.native_anywhere_in_aus)) == 2) { c(2, 2)} else { c(2, 2, 2)},name = "Native Status")+
    
    geom_text(data = crop_ml_wol, aes(label = location, geometry = geometry), col="grey40", stat = "sf_coordinates", size = 3) +
    
    # plot design
    coord_sf() +
    theme_bw() + theme(legend.key = element_rect(fill="grey90")) +
    scale_x_continuous( expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +

    labs(x = "", y="")
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(WKDir,"output_wol/plots/crop_cost_rast_wol_herb.png"),
    width = 10,
    height = 15,
    dpi = 300)
```
